edits.before: - Akshan Heroic Swing: matchup-defining — His swing engage/escape — fight only while it is down. It governs your forward steps. - E Shocking Orb spent on poke is a death you scheduled. - Hold the R for the fight that decides something.

edits.before: Q the last-hit from beyond his answer range, W the lateral dodge, and walk — a one-way trade he can only end by leaving the lane.
edits.after: His third-hit passive shields him — force Dirty Fighting's shield out with poke first, and save the stun to knock him off Heroic Swing.

edits.before: Spending E on chip and then watching the dash you bought it for arrive on schedule — the stun is your only 'no' and everyone knows it.
edits.after: Comeuppance deals damage off your MISSING health — the half-HP Q you greed is exactly the bar his stored bullets were priced against. Reset.
